# Examples

## Generate Full Report

```r
# Render the engagement report
quarto::quarto_render("engagement_report.qmd", 
                      execute_params = list(
                        data_file = "data_files/rds/merged_data.rds",
                        output_year = 2023
                      ))
```

## Analyze Participation Trends

```r
# Load data and calculate metrics
data <- readRDS("merged_data.rds")
district_data <- calc_district_metrics(data)
trends <- prepare_district_trends(district_data)

# Get ELA participation trends
ela_trends <- calc_participation_trends(trends, "ELA")
print(ela_trends)
```

## Find Districts with Dual Challenges

```r
# Identify districts with both low participation and high absenteeism
dual_problems <- calc_dual_challenges(trends, "MATH", 2023)
print(dual_problems)
```

## Analyze Student Group Gaps

```r
# Find student groups with largest participation gaps
participation_gaps <- calc_group_participation_gaps(trends, "ELA", 2023)
print(participation_gaps)
```

## Variance Decomposition

```r
# Understand between vs within district variation
variance_results <- calc_variance_decomposition(data)
print(variance_results)
```
